data.body: Operator decision 2026-11-03 (scope): requirement — the client must be able to run offline without knowledge of the remote store. Rescope this ticket to the plan-review side: (a) review-plan refuses, before any LLM call or charge, only when the clone is provably BEHIND or DIVERGED from its already-fetched remote-tracking ref (purely local check, freshness.py; never-fetched/no-remote = fresh); (b) unpublished local writes (push-pending marker) no longer make the store stale for ANY gate — review-plan, claim (gates.py store_freshness) and close (close_precheck assert_gate_store_fresh) — so an offline client can review, claim and close after local writes; accepted trade-off: a certificate can cover events the shared store has not yet received; (c) job status labels a reused/replayed REVIEW_RESULT as replayed and says whether this run decided the verdict; (d) the failure message suggests sign-review only when a PASS result file exists. The 2 DIVERGED criteria are dropped (the Nov 1 DIVERGED report was accurate; the lock fix is radiant-benighted-warbler, landed 25bce6c0550). The 'result file written even when signing fails' criterion already passes on main and is dropped.
